prompt:
Create a finished illustration for a public book-summary library for adult
readers. Use a calm, contemporary illustrated-book style: hand-painted gouache,
soft matte pigment, restrained pencil details, and a subtle warm ivory paper
texture. Use a consistent palette of muted sage and olive green, warm ochre,
natural wood brown, and warm ivory, with dark brown or charcoal details. Keep
saturation restrained and lighting soft and natural. Give the scene generous
breathing room, a clear focal point, and simple, recognizable forms that remain
readable on a phone. When people are relevant, depict believable adults with
natural proportions, respectful expressions, and ordinary clothing. Use the same
medium, palette, texture, and level of detail across the illustration. Avoid
photorealism, glossy 3D, neon colors, cinematic effects, heavy black outlines,
childish clipart, ornamental clutter, and a different art style in each panel.
No readable text, captions, logos, watermarks, fake book covers, or invented
author portraits. Keep all explanations and essential labels outside the
generated image.

Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: square book-summary hero, at least 1024 by 1024 pixels.
Reference image: the supplied starting-small.webp is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its gouache medium, restrained sage and ochre palette, warm ivory paper texture, soft lighting and visual density. Do not copy its person, desk, room or composition.
Subject: a symbolic scene about the quiet erosion of democratic safeguards, for How Democracies Die by Steven Levitsky and Daniel Ziblatt. In a quiet civic courtyard, a plain wooden ballot box with a narrow slot and one blank ivory ballot stands centrally on a low broad stone plinth. A simple low stone balustrade surrounds the plinth in a wide arc. On the right of the arc a few balusters have been carefully removed; their matching stones lie neatly beside the new gap, suggesting gradual dismantling rather than explosion or war. In the soft background a modest civic building has open doors. No people, national flags, party symbols, lettering, scales or book covers. One clear metaphor: voting remains visible while its protective safeguards are taken apart. Balanced square composition, generous open space, large recognizable forms, soft natural daylight, all important elements inset from the edges. This is a conceptual illustration, not a reconstruction of an actual event.

reference_images.role: Style reference only; inspected before generation.
